subject: Onboarding — PO control tokens & SKU mapping request
messages: Subject: Onboarding — PO control tokens & SKU mapping request

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get Skylance set up. Two quick procurement items so we can issue the initial PO and set spend controls:

1) Can you confirm whether Skylance requires a single PO per billing account or per product SKU? We often use PO tokenization (one administrative PO with multiple PO tokens mapped to SKUs) to keep line items clear.

2) We need a completed onboarding form and your preferred remit address for the PO. I attached our onboarding form (skylance_onboard_form.pdf) — can you return that with the remit/PO billing contact filled in?

3) Proposed provisional spend cap for the first quarter: $75,000. Please confirm if that aligns with Skylance procurement. We can split into spend buckets if you prefer (e.g., infra vs. support).

Action items: please return the completed form and a one-line confirmation on SKU vs. account-level PO behavior. I’ll coordinate with Finance to seed the PO token and issue a stub PO for testing.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sr. Partnerships, Redwood Inference

attachments: skylance_onboard_form.pdf
Subject: Re: Onboarding — PO control tokens & SKU mapping request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks — attaching our procurement intake. Quick answers below: 

- We prefer a single PO per contract but need line-item visibility by SKU (finance requires SKU-level rollups). A tokenized approach (admin PO + token per SKU) would work well for us.

- Confirming the remit: Skylance Systems, AP Invoicing, 1200 Harbor Way, Suite 300, San Diego, CA 92101. Invoice email: ar@skylance.io

- The $75k provisional cap is acceptable to start. We will revisit at the end of Q3.

Attached: skylance_procurement_intake.pdf

Elena
Head of Procurement, Skylance Systems

Team — quick SKU review notes: 

- The draft sku_map_v1.csv looks good overall. A couple of line-item corrections required:
  * internal_sku RUNTIME-STD should map to skylance_sku SKY-R-STD (we had a typo in the draft).
  * The unit_price for LICENSE-SEAT needs to be split into two lines: LICENSE-SEAT (seat fee) and LICENSE-SUPPORT (annual support) so Skylance can allocate to separate GL buckets.

- For accounting, we recommend creating two PO tokens under the parent PO: SKY-449-RT for runtime and SKY-449-LIC for license/support. Finance will hold the spend cap against the parent PO (SKY-449) and allow tokens to consume from their allocated buckets.

Requesting Marissa to create the provisional parent PO (SKY-449) and two token records. I’ll send the corrected sku_map_v2.csv after the typo fix.

Priyom
Manager, Revenue Ops
